body:
Fixes #313

## What / why

`pnpm run test:run` was timing out on vitest's 5000ms default under real load, on tests unrelated to whatever diff was being verified — three occurrences in one day, one caused a false verifier BLOCK on a PR that was fine. The decided policy (`docs/research/2026-09-21-foundation-audit/evidence/TESTING.md` §4): explicit per-test timeouts, never the 5s default; no quarantine list; keep the verifier's "re-run at origin/main" advice.

Re-measured from scratch (the issue's file list predates #323/#324's `node`/`jsdom` project split). Ran `pnpm run test:run` 3 times with 2 other agent processes active on this machine (real background contention, not synthetic) and collected per-test durations via `--reporter=json`. The consistent top of the ranking is jsdom tests that mount the full `CompactToolbar`/`Shell`/`RightActionBar` tree and drive real `userEvent` interactions, plus one genuinely compute-heavy `src/core/hdl` permutation test:

| Test | 3-run max | % of 5000ms default |
|---|---|---|
| `CompactToolbar.test.tsx` › clicking the same gate again clears placementMode | 3052ms | 61% |
| `TestResultsPanel.integration.test.tsx` › runs a chip, sees a passing result | 2642ms | 53% |
| `RightActionBar.test.tsx` › clicking Info trigger opens drawer | 2582ms | 52% |
| `Shell.integration.test.tsx` › renders compact toolbar and right action bar | 2468ms | 49% |
| `renderShell.test.tsx` › mounts the full DOM shell | 2415ms | 48% |
| `CompactToolbar.test.tsx` › gate popover lists all 16 chips | 2214ms | 44% |
| `compiler.test.ts` › permutation invariance N=2 (exhaustive, not load) | 2053ms | 41% |

Everything else measured stayed below 40% of the default (e.g. `truthTable.test.ts`'s 2^ceiling enumeration at 1814ms/36%) and was left alone — a timeout raised on a test that never needed it hides a future regression.

## Fix

Explicit per-test timeouts (third arg to `it()`), sized from measurement, documented in-file:
- `SLOW_MOUNT_TIMEOUT_MS = 10000` (~3.3–4.1x the worst DOM-mount duration measured) on the 6 tests above that mount the full shell/toolbar tree, across `CompactToolbar.test.tsx`, `Shell.integration.test.tsx`, `TestResultsPanel.integration.test.tsx`, `RightActionBar.test.tsx`, `renderShell.test.tsx`.
- `PERMUTATION_TIMEOUT_MS = 8000` on `compiler.test.ts`'s exhaustive test — genuinely slow because it's exhaustive over every permutation/depth pattern, not load-induced, so it gets its own constant and comment rather than sharing the DOM-mount one.

**No global `testTimeout` raised** — every other test still fails fast at the 5000ms default. No assertion weakened, nothing skipped/`.only`'d.

**Demonstrated under load:** `pnpm run test:run` × 3 concurrent processes on this machine (plus another agent's own vitest run happening at the same time) — each run took ~191s vs ~81s solo (2.5–4.7x slower from the contention), all three finished **140/140 files, 2251/2251 tests, 0 failures**.

**Folded in cheaply:** `.test.mts`/`.test.js` anywhere in `src/` were collected by neither vitest project (verified with throwaway files, pre-existing rather than a regression, noted while re-deriving the current slow-test list). `vite.config.ts`'s `ALL_TESTS` glob now includes `mts`/`js` — a real one-line fix since 0 files use those extensions today, so nothing that currently runs changes. It's a partial fix: a future `.test.mts` under a `NODE_TEST_DIR` still lands in `jsdom` rather than `node`, since widening the node-project regex too needs a `.mts`-vs-`.mtsx`-shaped rule this repo has no precedent for — left as-is rather than guessed at.

`docs/harness/verifier-brief.md`'s "a failure you cannot tie to the diff is a machine problem until re-run at origin/main" advice is **kept deliberately, not removed** — TESTING.md §4 already says to keep it, and it's a general safety net for flakes this fix doesn't claim to eliminate (unmeasured tests, environment hiccups), not specific to the tests fixed here.

`docs/harness/ledger.md` row added.

## Definition of done (worktree, fix/313-explicit-timeouts @ 843bd26)
- `pnpm run lint` ✔ (typecheck + eslint + lint:layers + lint:e2e-exports, 0 new layer violations, 0 dead e2e exports)
- `pnpm run test:run` ✔ 140 files / 2251 tests, 0 failures
- `pnpm run build` ✔
- `pnpm run lint:docs` ✔
- Issue verification command `pnpm run test:run` ✔ (same run as above)

Model: Sonnet (risk:1, mechanical/test-infrastructure fix).

## Reviewable lines
`git diff --numstat origin/main...HEAD`: 95 insertions / 33 deletions across 8 files (128 total) — all test files + `vite.config.ts` + one ledger row; test-file changes are excluded from the 400-line budget per `implementer-brief.md`.
